title: South Korea's privacy commission starts emergency response after 1,019 personal-data breach reports this year
date_note: Both articles of 27 Nov report the commission's announcement that day; neither gives an earlier day.
geo_basis: country stated by the sources; pin at the capital, Seoul
summary: Asiae reports that personal-data breach reports received from January to October totalled 1,019, already more than double the 447 of last year. Both Asiae and Newsis report the Personal Information Protection Commission is starting intensive management for three months from next month. Asiae says the commission named the spread of AI-based hacking as the main background.
plain: South Korea's privacy commission says breach reports this year reached 1,019, already more than double last year's 447, and will run three months of intensive management from next month.
exec: South Korea's privacy commission reports 1,019 breach reports from January to October and starts three months of intensive management from next month.

evidence.quote: 올해 1~10월 접수된 개인정보 유출 신고 건수는 총 1019건으로, 지난 한 해 건수(447건)의 2배를 이미 넘어섰다.

validation.note: Asia Economic Daily Korea and Newsis each report the commission's announcement of 1,019 reports and the three-month intensive management; the commission's own page was not read.

review.note: Compared 1,019/447 figures, three-month intensive management, AI background and date against Asiae and Newsis
